{{Otheruses|librarian}}
[[File:Librarian_FH.png|thumb|right|250px|A Jedi Librarian in the Jedi Archives.]]
A '''librarian''' was an individual who worked at or were in charge of libraries and archives. [[Librarian droid/Legends|Librarian droids]] such as [[Information cataloging droid|Kalibac librarian droids]] were sometimes used for this task as well.

==Jedi Librarians==
The Jedi Order had several libraries, including the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] and the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] on Coruscant, as well as several branches, such as the [[Jedi Archives (Ossus)|Ossus]] and [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Tython Archives]]. These were all established, operated, and managed by [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivists]] such as [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]], [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]], and [[Gnost-Dural]].

==Other Libraries==
The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] was known to have had a [[Death Star Library|library]], which was operated by [[Atour Riten]]. [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputers]] were used by a library on [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]].
